entries.easy_read:
I want to say something.
I ask first.

entries.text: Yesterday I packed forty orders. Today I will do the same.
entries.easy_read:
I say what I did yesterday.
I say what I will do today.

entries.text: One thing is blocking me: the label machine is down.
entries.easy_read:
One thing stops my work.
The label machine is broken.

entries.text: I will take that up and report back tomorrow.
entries.easy_read:
I will do that job.
I will tell you tomorrow.

entries.text: Sorry, could you go back to the previous point?
entries.easy_read:
You went too fast.
Please go back one step.

I think the same.
I say yes.

entries.text: That is outside my work, but I can ask the stores team.
entries.easy_read:
That is not my job.
I can ask the right team.

entries.text: Could you share what the meeting is about beforehand?
entries.easy_read:
I want to know the topics first.
Then I can get ready.

entries.text: Could we have one person speak at a time, please?
entries.easy_read:
Many people talk together.
I cannot follow.
Please speak one by one.

entries.text: I am writing this down so I remember it correctly.
entries.easy_read:
I write your words.
Then I will not forget.

entries.text: So my action is to check the stock by Friday.
entries.easy_read:
I say my job again.
I must check stock by Friday.

There is a lot of work.
I ask who does what.

entries.text: Sorry I am late. Please carry on, I will catch up.
entries.easy_read:
I came late.
I say sorry.
Please keep going.

entries.text: I have an idea that might help. May I share it?
entries.easy_read:
I thought of something good.
Can I tell everyone?

entries.text: Is there anything else before we finish?
entries.easy_read:
The meeting is nearly done.
I ask if anyone has more.

entries.text: Could someone send the notes afterwards?
entries.easy_read:
I cannot write and listen together.
Please send the notes later.
